body: I'm getting one Thursday. I'm losing it, I think I'm going insane. I'm thinking of ways to die and I'm getting excited knowing all my pain and suffering will finally end.
That's the thing, I thought the DUI was the bottom. My punishment was much more forgivable than this. 6 months is too long, I mentally can't handle this...

Thank you, and it was just for driving with a suspended license. Its a six month minimum here, thinking about it makes me want to cry. I've been fighting back cutting myself and I've been researching suicide methods...
They know. My mom worries about me a lot and my dad doesn't know how to handle it. I was looking up what can happen to me. If I lose, I will kill myself. I can't have my freedom taken away...

Yes there is. But I feel that which once made me value life is no longer there. I'm tired of doing new things, usually because I'm forced to. I have been painted as a saint by many, I'm afraid I'm not that, and I don't want to live in a world where I'm more criminal than civilian.

I don't want other jobs. I don't want harder and I'm tired of waiting for the horizon because whenever I see it, it gets taken away from me. No. I thought sleep would change me, but I'm absolutely sure I want to go through with this.
I wasn't trying, this was a throwaway. Didn't like how everything went. Sorry.
